rule.classification: dE0 = E0(s1) - E0(s0) under Turner 2004 counts (integer dcal/mol): 0 is a tie flip, > 0 a real reordering
rule.interval: real reorderings / 11,970 sequences; bootstrap 95% percentile CI, 2000 draws over sequences, seed SeedSequence([20261012, 9, point])
rule.label: EXPLORATORY; written before any refold (the user's instruction)
rule.rule_user: the headline reports real reorderings, with the total changed and the tie-flip count beside it. A reviewer can dismiss tie flips as arbitrary, but can't dismiss reorderings.
